sections.heading: Proposal Summary
sections.text: This proposal, SYN-SYNCP000133-P1, was presented by SANOFI (the Supplier) to Riverbend Physician Alliance 133 on June 8, 2026.

sections.heading: Supplier Concession
sections.text: Supplier concession: an administrative fee of 2.75%.

sections.heading: Supplier Request
sections.text: Supplier request: a commitment of 140 Influenza doses per year.

sections.heading: Proposal Status
sections.text: Status of this proposal: countered by the Customer.
